name: Chichi's Bread Run: Arcade
summary: Stand at the oven and bread stacks up in your hands. Pile it high and run it to the display - customers grab a loaf and head to the register. Step on the cash at the register to collect it, then stand on the floor pads to buy new ovens, displays and tables. Hire staff to carry bread and ring up sales, and upgrade run speed, tray size, flyers and bread price.
